name: NBA 2K27 Shot Trainer
description: Record separate Standing Still, Off-Dribble and Fade-Away baselines, enter game feedback, convert to Lua and assign a controller input or paddle. Tune each shot using timing/tempo feedback and editable millisecond sliders. Requires Studio beta.41 or newer.

shots.label: Standing Still
shots.instructions: Stand still in your practice area and record one complete shot attempt.

shots.label: Off-Dribble
shots.instructions: Record your dribble or movement into one shot. Use the left stick for the setup and reserve the shot input for one complete attempt.

shots.label: Fade-Away
shots.instructions: Record the movement into your fade-away and one complete shot. Keep the same player, animation and practice conditions while tuning.
